title: Crush Enchanted Fruit
description: This is just a very simple datapack to allow you to crush Quark's enchanted fruit in Create crushing wheels.
body:
Just a simple datapack for Minecraft 1.19.2-1.20 that adds a recipe for Quark's enchanted fruit item in Create's crushing wheels.
The resulting items are the following: - 100% for 3 nuggets of experience - 25% for an extra nugget of experience This is my first time uploading to Modrinth so lmk if there are any issues.
^-^
